group: Zone.getNS() – basic functionality and copy semantics

cases.description: When the internal NS field is null, getNS() should propagate the NPE that occurs when the RRset constructor receives a null argument. This verifies that the method does not silently swallow the error.

cases.expected: RRset instance that is equal (same records) to the internal NS but not the same object reference
cases.description: Populate the private NS field with a non‑empty RRset (using reflection or addRRset). getNS() must return a new RRset that contains the same records, confirming that a defensive copy is created.

cases.expected: original internal NS unchanged after mutating the returned RRset
cases.description: After calling getNS(), add a new Record to the returned RRset. The internal NS stored inside the Zone should remain unchanged, proving that the copy is deep enough for the test’s purposes.

cases.expected: RRset instance with zero records when internal NS is an empty RRset
cases.description: Set the internal NS to an empty RRset (no records). getNS() should return a new empty RRset (size 0), ensuring the method works for the edge case of an empty set.

group: Zone.getNS() – distinct instances on successive calls

cases.expected: Two successive calls to getNS() return two different RRset objects (different identity) even though they contain equal records
cases.description: Ensures that getNS() does not cache the RRset instance and always creates a fresh defensive copy.

group: Zone.getNS() – snapshot semantics after internal mutation

cases.expected: RRset returned before the internal NS is mutated remains unchanged after the internal NS is modified
cases.description: Calls getNS(), then adds a new NS Record directly to the Zone's internal NS (using reflection or addRRset). The previously obtained RRset must still reflect the original state, confirming snapshot behaviour.

group: Zone.getNS() – copies all records when multiple NS records are present

cases.expected: RRset returned by getNS() contains exactly the same number and content of NS records as the internal NS (e.g., 3 NS records) and is a different object reference
cases.description: Populates the internal NS with several distinct NS records. Verifies that the copy includes every record, not just the first one.

cases.expected: All concurrent invocations of getNS() complete without throwing exceptions and each returns a valid RRset copy
cases.description: Spawns multiple threads (e.g., 10) that simultaneously call getNS() on the same Zone instance whose internal NS is non‑null. Confirms that the read‑write lock protects the method from race conditions.

group: Zone.getNS() – returned RRset can be mutated independently (remove operation)

cases.expected: Removing a Record from the RRset returned by getNS() does not affect the internal NS stored in the Zone
cases.description: After obtaining the copy via getNS(), call removeRecord on the copy. The internal NS inside the Zone must still contain the original record, demonstrating that the copy is fully independent.
